name: door hinge
definition: hinge on which a door, gate or window leaf swings (butt and other patterns are named forms).
notes: Butt, tee, parliament, flush, spring and other hinge types listed under door hinges.

name: cabinet knob or pull
definition: knob or pull handle fitted to a cabinet door or drawer (K-196).
notes: Sold as cupboard door knobs; cupboard handles are a sibling category.

name: door handle
definition: lever, knob or pull handle set for a door, without a lock (a lockset with a lock is B8).
notes: Handle sets by lock type: latch, lock, euro lock, bathroom; sold without lock body in latch sets.

name: latch
definition: catch that holds a door or gate shut without a key.
notes: Gate latches (ring, auto-locking field-gate) sold; no door latch category in this fetch.

name: door bolt
definition: sliding bolt that secures a door or gate from one side.
notes: Sold as Bolts (tower, surface, Brenton) separate from hasps and padlocks.

name: hasp
definition: hinged slotted plate and staple that take a padlock.
notes: Type filter Hasp & Staples, sold for gates, sheds and storage boxes.

name: bracket
definition: general bracket or shelf support fixed to a wall or structure (not one made for one screen or speaker).
notes: Shelf brackets category; brackets fix shelves, not screens.

name: letter plate
definition: letter flap and plate fitted in a door (K-188).
notes: Letter plates sold in door furniture; letter boxes are a separate category.

name: regulatory and safety sign
definition: sign that gives a safety, fire, hazard or legal instruction (K-192).
notes: Prohibition, mandatory, warning, emergency and fire safety signs sold; BS EN ISO 7010.

name: compression fitting
definition: fitting that seals on a pipe by a nut squeezing an olive.
notes: Compression is a Pipe Fitting System filter; shape (elbow, coupler, tee) is a separate filter.

name: push-fit fitting
definition: fitting that grips and seals a pipe pushed into it, with no tools or heat.
notes: Push-Fit is the largest system (454 of 775 fittings).

name: solder-ring fitting
definition: copper fitting with an integral ring of solder, sealed by heating.
notes: Solder Ring is a Pipe Fitting System filter.

name: end-feed fitting
definition: copper fitting sealed by solder fed into the joint while heated.
notes: End Feed is a Pipe Fitting System filter.

name: press-fit fitting
definition: fitting sealed by crimping onto the pipe with a press tool.
notes: Press-Fit is a Pipe Fitting System filter; Conex Banninger B Press listed.

name: pipe
definition: plumbing, heating, gas or water supply pipe of copper, plastic or steel, sold by length or coil.
notes: Pipe listed as copper, PEX, PB, MDPE, waste and overflow pipe.

name: pipe clip
definition: clip or bracket that holds a pipe to a wall or joist.
notes: Pipe clips category of 80 products.

name: tap
definition: hand-operated valve that delivers water at a basin, sink, bath or outside (mixer taps included; K-186).
notes: Bathroom taps category; Toolstation lists exterior taps.

name: valve
definition: valve that shuts off or controls flow in a pipe (stop cock, isolating and radiator valves).
notes: Isolating, ball, stop, gate, check and thermostatic mixing valves listed.

name: waste fitting
definition: pipe and fitting for the waste outlet of a basin, sink or bath.
notes: Wastes category (130) beside traps.

name: trap
definition: water-sealed bend under an outlet that blocks drain gases.
notes: Traps category (181), split by bath, shower and basin application.

name: guttering
definition: gutter and downpipe sections and fittings that carry rainwater from a roof.
notes: Gutter, bends, brackets and guards sold as guttering; half round, ogee and square line.

name: shower tray
definition: base set under a shower that collects water to its waste (K-186).
notes: Shower trays by shape; riser kits sold alongside.

name: shower enclosure
definition: glass or panel walls and door around a shower.
notes: Shower enclosures by shape and door type.

name: bath panel
definition: panel that covers the side or end of a bath.
notes: Front and end bath panels, 68 products.

name: cable
definition: fixed-wiring mains cable (twin and earth and the like).
notes: Twin and earth cable (6242Y) sold by drum.

name: flex
definition: flexible mains cord for connecting appliances and fittings.
notes: Flexes listed beside cable and armoured cable.

name: armoured cable
definition: mains cable with a steel-wire armour layer for burial or exposed runs.
notes: Armoured cable (6943X 3-core) sold by coil.

name: cable clip
definition: clip that fixes a cable to a wall or surface.
notes: Cable clips by shape: flat single, round, P-shape, shotgun.

name: switch
definition: wall switch for a mains circuit or light.
notes: Switches and sockets sold as one wiring-accessory category.

name: socket-outlet
definition: wall socket that takes mains plugs (types A to O are named forms).
notes: Sockets sold with switches in one category of 2730 products.

name: mains plug
definition: rewireable or moulded plug for a mains flex (types A to O are named forms).
notes: Electric plugs category: 13A fused and 5A round pin plugs.

name: fuse
definition: cartridge or rewireable fuse that breaks a circuit on overload.
notes: Cartridge fuses 5A to 30A; plug fuses sold in plugs and fuses category.

name: ceiling rose
definition: ceiling fitting where a pendant flex joins the fixed wiring (B-18).
notes: Ceiling rose light fitting; product type Ceiling Rose, 2A, loop-in terminals.

name: extension lead
definition: flex with a mains plug and one or more sockets, on a reel or not.
notes: Extension leads by gangs, switched or not, and surge protection.

name: consumer unit
definition: fuse box or board that holds a building's breakers or fuses.
notes: Consumer units (fuse boards), populated or not, by module and way.

name: wall and ceiling paint
definition: interior paint for walls and ceilings (emulsion is a binder, not a kind).
notes: Wall and ceiling emulsion; types durable, kitchens and bathrooms; finish matt to silk.

name: masonry paint
definition: exterior paint for brick, render and masonry.
notes: Masonry Paint listed as a paint type.

name: fence paint
definition: paint or treatment for timber fences and sheds.
notes: Fence Paint listed as a paint type.

name: floor paint
definition: hard-wearing paint for concrete, wood or garage floors.
notes: Floor Paint listed as a paint type.

name: radiator paint
definition: heat-resistant paint for radiators and pipes.
notes: Radiator Paint listed as a paint type.

name: tile paint
definition: paint made to adhere to glazed tiles.
notes: Tile Paint listed as a paint type.

name: furniture paint
definition: paint made for furniture and cabinets.
notes: Furniture Paint listed beside Garden Furniture Paint.

name: woodwork and metal paint (trim paint)
definition: gloss, satin or eggshell paint for doors, trim and metalwork (gloss and satinwood are `gloss_level` values).
notes: Wood and metal paint in gloss, satin, eggshell finishes.

name: spray paint
definition: paint in an aerosol can.
notes: Spray Paint listed as a paint type.

name: primer
definition: primer or undercoat, the preparatory coat under a top coat (`coat_role` primer, undercoat, primer-undercoat, sealer).
notes: Undercoats and primers sold together; wood, wall and sealer primers.

name: stain
definition: coloured finish that soaks into wood and shows its grain.
notes: Wood stain category; exterior water- and solvent-based.

name: varnish
definition: clear or tinted film-forming finish for wood.
notes: Varnish category: interior, floor, yacht, exterior.

name: wood oil
definition: penetrating oil finish for wood (decking and furniture oils).
notes: Wood oil: finishing, Danish, teak, tung, linseed and wax oils.

name: wax
definition: wax finish rubbed into wood.
notes: Wood wax category, 17 products; floor wax and Black Bison wax.

name: sandpaper
definition: abrasive sheet or roll for hand or general use, not cut for one sander (K-12).
notes: Hand sanding sheets by grit, 10 packs, multi-material; sponges and pads too.
